newsitem.title: FRANCE: Airbus says in talks with USAir for planes.
newsitem.headline: Airbus says in talks with USAir for planes.

text.p: European plane consortium Airbus Industrie confirmed on Monday it was in negotiations with USAir Group Inc to sell it passenger jets.
"We are in talks with USAir, as we are with other airlines and potential customers around the world," an Airbus spokeswoman said. She declined to give further details of the talks.
The Wall Street Journal reported that USAir is considering buying up to 120 new jets worth more than $5 billion and has been talking to Airbus, Boeing and McDonnell Douglas.

Airbus is a consortium made up of French state-owned Ste Nationale Industrielle Aerospatiale, British Aerospace Plc, Daimler-Benz Aerospace, a unit of Daimler-Benz AG and Construcciones Aeronauticas SA (CASA) of Spain.
